Name: Seirah
ModernLocation: Unknown; in the hills of Ephraim
Description: Seirah, also spelled Seirath, was the place in the hills of Ephraim to which Ehud escaped after killing Eglon, king of Moab, and from which he sounded the trumpet to gather Israel.
BiblicalSignificance: Seirah is the rallying point of Ehud's deliverance: the escape route that became the muster for the defeat of Moab.
